The '''fourth battle of DS 5''' was the final engagement in the [[Battle for Honor]] campaign during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==The battle==
With [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]] trapped aboard the platform [[DS 5]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces immediately dispatched [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|''Alpha''-class Xg-1 Star Wings]] for an all out assault on the station. Gunboats [[Mu group|Mu]] again emerged from hyperspace near DS 5, closely escorted by [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]] from group [[Alpha group|Alpha]]. With intent to capture Admiral Harkov, the Imperial Gunboat's primary mission was to disable Platform DS 5, and any fleeing transport craft, while Avengers eliminated any intervening [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. Three minutes after Imperial starfighters arrived, [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport|Assault transports]] ''[[Omega]]'' would join them to disable and capture any remaining craft.

Imperial fighters met Rebel [[A-wing]] and [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing]] fighters moments after arrival. Dividing their forces, Gunboats and Avengers tackled incoming [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] fighters while still proceeding onto DS 5. The first transport craft attempting to flee was [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Geddawai]]''. ''Geddawai'' swiftly met the unrelenting barrage of Ion cannon fire from an Imperial Gunboat. Passing over the disabled ''Geddawai'', Gunboat ''Mu 2''{{'s}} passive scanners revealed Harkov was onboard. With ''Geddawai'' disabled, the shuttle ''[[Toten]]'' lifted off from the platform, soon followed by transport ''[[Kolermigon]]''. Again, Imperial Gunboats diverted, disabling ''Toten'' and ''Kolermigon'' with extreme prejudice. Shuttle ''Toten'' held only a decoy; however fleeing rebels occupied transport ''Kolermigon'', destined to meet Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].

Assault Transports ''Omega'' arrived right on schedule. With transport craft disabled, Imperial starfighters saw to the remaining Rebel fighters and the class C minefield around the station, further aiding ''Omega'' in capturing DS 5. With DS 5 disabled, [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Garrett]]'' arrived from hyperspace. No sooner had Imperial forces began cycling back to the ''Garrett'' to re-supply, than [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Olinor]]'' entered the system. Olinor launched [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] in a last ditch effort to rescue the impending doom of Admiral Harkov. To make matters worse more corvettes from ''[[Wurger]]'' arrived, soon joined by additional [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]], B-wing, and A-wing fighters. The rebel force desperately attempted to thwart the capture operation, but to no avail as Assault Transports had already moved into position.

After sustaining heavy damage to her shields, frigate ''Olinor'' broke contact from Imperial Star Destroyer ''Garrett'' and fled the system, soon followed by corvettes ''Wurger''. Meanwhile, Rebel starfighters lingered in the system, swiftly destroyed by Imperial pilots.

==Aftermath==
With Harkov in custody, he was brought before [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] aboard the ''Garrett''. After a brief interrogation, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] executed him for [[Treason/Legends|treason]].
